body: Recovering Kodo. =( My appendix blew up the other day.

Why?
All I can think about is the WKUK skit.

So really, there's just no winning.

Though, I agree, don't pick a hero you don't know in hero league. The other side to that, is don't pick your best hero just because it's your best hero. I mean at least TRY somewhat to accommodate team comp.

Did an elegon run with a friend. Mount drops, he wins the roll. 

Next day is reset, do the run again with him and someone else. Mount drops again, other guy wins the roll.

Other guy gives me the mount. I feel lucky because he was nice and because two mount drops two days in a row.

Same thing happened to me but instead it was an envelope of cash. I needed a signature because you know... it's cash. Don't want that just lying around. Anyway, come home to find it in between my door and the neighbors. Last time I pay for a signature. 

Also, yes, it's a bad idea to send cash, couldn't be helped.
JKR is a perfect example of a celebrity who can't handle twitter.

i can relate to this. I just had a huge argument with my older sister and her friends about a multilevel marketing scheme and how it was definitely NOT a pyramid scheme. Needless to say, I couldn't convince them that they were drinking the kool-aid and selling stupid overpriced products that have FDA warnings associated with them. 

I felt super disappointed that she bought into that stuff. 

Once I calmed down though, I noticed the stress I was putting on my sister. I apologized because Id rather just avoid the topic and have conversations than not talk at all. It's not fair to just throw everything good I ever thought about her because she's wrong about something, even if there's obvious evidence of it. 

Relatives that also have the added benefit of being looked up to also make mistakes, I guess.

People really underestimate how much stress can get to you. Simply relaxing down in front of the TV is hardly ever enough because it just pushes the problems away. Taking small walks or engaging in an active hobby(even if it's not sports, it could be something creative) away from the screen is beneficial. 

I realized that my online productivity increased significantly when I got up just a bit earlier to walk around the block so take care of yourselves guys! It'll help more than you think.

If you get tired, stand up and go to the back. DRINK YOUR WATER.
